Both responses are accurate. Every figure matches the source (142 to 156 lines per hour, 0.62 to 0.41 per cent, 17 per cent for new staff, 64 per cent preference, $210,000, 14-month payback), and both correctly flag the single-company, grocery-only limitation. Response B adds useful detail about the accuracy gain being smaller where error rates were already low and about gains settling within four weeks, but Response A conveys the core points too. Response B's bulleted structure is easy to scan, but it runs to roughly 130 words, breaking the explicit "under 120 words" limit. Response A comes in at about 110 words and keeps all the points a busy manager needs, including the payback and the heat-related comfort issue. Since the length cap was an explicit instruction, Response A is the better response.

Verdict: A
